glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 老师做实验以前先把窗打开，说这种气体虽然看不见，可是一旦在小房间里太多，人就会很不舒服。
工人检查管道的时候闻到一点怪味，后来发现不是水的问题，而是有少量气体正从一个地方慢慢往外漏。
医生解释时说，胃里气体太多也会让人一直觉得不舒服，所以吃饭太快的人最好先把速度放慢。

example_translations.translation: Before doing the experiment, the teacher opened the window first and said that although this gas cannot be seen, if too much of it builds up in a small room, people will feel very unwell.
While checking the pipe, the worker noticed a strange smell. It later turned out not to be a water problem, but a small amount of gas slowly leaking out from one spot.
The doctor explained that too much gas in the stomach can also keep a person feeling uncomfortable, so people who eat too quickly should slow down first.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这家小店一到下午就有面包的气味从后面飘出来，所以路过的人常常还没进门就先停下了。
房间关太久以后会有一点旧书和衣服放久了的气味，所以她每次进去以前都会先把窗打开。
医生提醒他，如果伤口突然有很重的气味，就不要再自己处理了，最好马上去医院让专业的人看看。

example_translations.translation: Every afternoon, the smell of bread drifts out from the back of this little shop, so people passing by often stop before they even go in.
If a room stays closed for too long, it can pick up the smell of old books and clothes that have been left sitting for too long, so she always opens the window before going in.
The doctor reminded him that if a wound suddenly gives off a strong odor, he should stop treating it on his own and go to the hospital right away to have a professional look at it.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 她说话不快，衣服也总是很简单，可是一走进会议室，大家还是会立刻注意到她很安静的气质。
这家书店地方不大，可是灯光、音乐和老板说话的方式放在一起，就有了一种很温和的气质。
很多人觉得气质只是天生的，可是老师说，一个人长期怎么读书、怎么待人，也会慢慢写在脸上。

example_translations.translation: She does not speak quickly and her clothes are always simple, but the moment she walks into the meeting room, people still immediately notice her calm temperament.
This bookstore is not large, but the lighting, the music, and the way the owner speaks together give it a very gentle character.
Many people think temperament is only something a person is born with, but the teacher said that how someone reads and treats others over time also slowly shows on the face.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 他在会上没有马上反对，而是先换了一个更恰当的说法，所以原来大家都不太敢说的话，后来也能接着说下去了。
医生说，面对老人这种情况，最恰当的办法不是马上让他多活动，而是先把睡眠慢慢调整过来。
老师批改文章时提醒我们，例子再多，如果位置放得不恰当，读的人还是会觉得整段话没有力量。

example_translations.translation: At the meeting, he did not oppose the idea right away. Instead, he switched to a more appropriate way of saying it, so later even the things people had not really dared to say could be said.
The doctor said that in this kind of situation for an elderly person, the most appropriate approach is not to make him move more right away, but to gradually get his sleep back into order first.
While marking the essay, the teacher reminded us that no matter how many examples there are, if they are not placed appropriately, the reader will still feel that the whole passage lacks force.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adverb.

examples.sentence: 我们到车站的时候，前面那班车恰好开走，所以大家只好站在风里又等了二十分钟。
她把那件外套拿出来一试，长度和颜色都恰好合适，所以母亲当场就说不用再挑别的了。
父亲原来以为时间会来不及，可是路上没有怎么堵车，所以他们到医院的时候，医生也恰好刚看完前一个病人。

example_translations.translation: When we arrived at the station, the earlier train had just left, so we had no choice but to stand in the wind and wait another twenty minutes.
She tried on that coat, and the length and color were both just right, so her mother immediately said there was no need to look for another one.
My father had originally thought there would not be enough time, but the road was not very blocked, so when they arrived at the hospital, the doctor had happened to finish with the previous patient.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adverb.

examples.sentence: 很多人以为他不爱说话就是没有想法，可是情况恰恰相反，他每次开口都已经把问题想得很深了。
父亲原来怕老师把速度放慢以后孩子会更着急，可是后来才发现，这样安排恰恰让他更愿意学下去。
很多人原来以为这个办法太慢不会有用，可是结果恰恰相反，问题反而比以前解决得更快了。

example_translations.translation: Many people think that because he does not like to talk, he has no ideas, but the situation is just the opposite: every time he speaks, he has already thought the issue through very deeply.

My father had originally worried that if the teacher slowed the pace down, the child would become even more anxious, but later he discovered that this arrangement was exactly what made him more willing to keep learning.
Many people had originally thought this method was too slow to be useful, but the result was just the opposite: the problem was actually solved faster than before.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 天快黑的时候，母亲一边牵着孩子过马路，一边回头看后面的车有没有真的慢下来。
老人出门散步时总爱牵着那条小狗，不是怕它跑远，而是觉得这样走起来心里更安心。
这个决定表面上只牵到一个部门，可是后面的时间、人员和费用一改，其他安排也得跟着变。

example_translations.translation: As it was getting dark, the mother led the child across the road by the hand while looking back to see whether the cars behind had really slowed down.
When the old man goes out for a walk, he always likes to lead that little dog along, not because he is afraid it will run far away, but because it makes him feel more at ease as he walks.
On the surface, this decision involves only one department, but once the schedule, staffing, and costs behind it are changed, the other arrangements have to change along with them.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. Sense splitting and part of speech may need refinement before example generation.

examples.sentence: 这种变化看上去只是一个行业里的事，可是真正关系到的，其实是千家万户每天最普通的生活安排。
这种简单又省电的小机器后来走进了千家万户，不是因为样子特别新，而是大家真的每天都用得上。
如果一项服务想长期做好，就不能只看少数人的反应，还得听听千家万户每天最普通的需要是什么。

example_translations.translation: This change may look like something happening only within one industry, but what it is really connected to is the most ordinary daily life arrangements of countless households.
This simple, power-saving little machine later entered countless homes, not because it looked especially new, but because people truly used it every day.
If a service wants to be done well over the long term, it cannot look only at the reactions of a few people; it also has to listen to the most ordinary daily needs of countless households.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective, verb.

examples.sentence: 他明明已经把最难的部分都做好了，可是开会的时候还是很谦虚，只说自己只是先试了一下。
老师一直很谦虚，从不拿自己的经验压人，所以刚进公司的年轻人也愿意把真实问题告诉他。
真正让人舒服的谦虚，不是一直否定自己，而是知道自己哪里做得好，也知道哪里还要继续学。

example_translations.translation: He had clearly already finished the hardest part, but he was still very modest in the meeting and said only that he had simply tried it first.
The teacher has always been modest and never uses his own experience to pressure others, so even the young people who have just joined the company are willing to tell him their real problems.
The kind of modesty that truly makes people feel comfortable is not constantly denying yourself, but knowing what you have done well and also knowing where you still need to keep learning.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这个行业眼前虽然不算轻松，可是如果技术和服务能一起跟上，很多人还是觉得它的前景很值得期待。
老板决定留下这批年轻人，不只是看他们现在会多少，更是因为公司看重这个方向以后的前景。
父亲年轻时选工作最在意稳定，现在却常提醒孩子，判断前景的时候也要看看自己是不是真的喜欢。

example_translations.translation: Although this industry is not especially easy right now, many people still feel its prospects are worth looking forward to if technology and service can improve together.
The boss decided to keep this group of young people not only because of what they can do now, but also because the company values the future prospects of this direction.

When my father was young, the thing he cared most about in choosing a job was stability, but now he often reminds children that when judging prospects, they should also ask whether they truly like it.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 教练没有因为他第一次成绩一般就放弃，因为从动作和反应来看，这个孩子其实很有潜力。
这个地方过去一直不太热闹，可是路一通、学校也多起来以后，大家慢慢都看到了它的潜力。
老师说，一个团队有没有潜力，不只是看最会说话的人，而要看安静的人有没有机会把本事用出来。

example_translations.translation: The coach did not give up on him just because his first result was ordinary, because judging from his movements and reactions, the child actually has a lot of potential.
This place used to be quiet, but after the roads opened and more schools appeared, people gradually began to see its potential.
The teacher said that whether a team has potential does not depend only on the person who speaks best, but on whether the quiet people also have a chance to use their abilities.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这个项目后来进展得还算顺，可是如果没有前期那些一点一点整理资料的工作，后面根本走不到今天。
医生解释说，很多病在前期并不会特别疼，所以人最容易因为感觉不严重，就一直往后拖。
她刚接手的时候花了很多时间做前期沟通，不是因为动作慢，而是怕后面真出问题时谁也接不上。

example_translations.translation: This project later moved ahead fairly smoothly, but without all the early-stage work of sorting through materials bit by bit, it never could have reached where it is today.
The doctor explained that many illnesses are not especially painful in the early stage, so people most easily keep putting them off because they feel the situation is not serious.

When she first took over, she spent a lot of time on early-stage communication, not because she was slow, but because she was afraid that once a real problem came later, no one would be able to pick things up.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 公司愿意给大家更大的自由，不过前提是每个人都要把自己的部分按时做好，不要总等别人来提醒。
讨论是不是继续投资以前，最基本的前提应该先说清楚，就是这件事到底能不能长期服务真正需要它的人。
父亲同意这件事让我自己定，但他的前提很简单，如果还有不懂的地方，要先告诉家里。

example_translations.translation: The company is willing to give everyone more freedom, but the premise is that each person must finish their own part on time instead of always waiting for others to remind them.
Before discussing whether to continue investing, the most basic premise should be made clear first: whether this thing can truly serve the people who need it over the long term.
My father agreed to let me decide this matter myself, but his condition was simple: if there was still something I did not understand, I had to tell the family first.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 两个方案都能解决眼前的问题，不过前者花的钱更少，后者用起来更快，所以老板现在还没有最后决定。
老师给了学生两个办法，前者先让人愿意开口，后者再让人把话说得更清楚。
我们后来比较了线上和线下两种安排，前者省时间，后者更容易让第一次来的人马上进入状态。

example_translations.translation: Both plans can solve the immediate problem, but the former costs less money while the latter works more quickly in practice, so the boss still has not made a final decision.
The teacher gave the students two methods: the former first gets people willing to speak, while the latter helps them express themselves more clearly.
Later we compared two kinds of arrangements, online and offline. The former saves time, while the latter makes it easier for first-time participants to get into the rhythm right away.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 孩子看到以前人用过的枪时，先觉得很特别，后来听老师说完以后，才明白为什么大家都不想再看到这种东西。
活动开始以前，老师先提醒大家，看到像枪的东西不要自己去碰，要先告诉旁边的大人。
路边有人看到一个像枪的东西，就先叫大家离远一点，后来才知道那只是一个孩子掉下的玩具。

example_translations.translation: When the child saw a gun that people had used in the past, it seemed striking at first, but after listening to the teacher finish speaking, the child understood why people do not want to see this kind of thing again.
Before the activity started, the teacher reminded everyone that if they saw something like a gun, they should not touch it themselves and should first tell an adult nearby.
Someone by the roadside saw an object that looked like a gun and first told everyone to stay a little farther away, only to learn later that it was just a toy a child had dropped.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 房子太旧的时候，墙壁一到下雨天就会有水，所以母亲每年春天都要把旁边的东西再往外放一点。
老师让大家先别急着往墙壁上贴新的画，因为上面还有很多灰，没有擦干净的话很快又会往下掉。
医生说，孩子总对着太近的墙壁看书也不好，最好还是把桌子往后移一点，让眼睛前面更开一些。

example_translations.translation: When a house gets too old, water appears on the walls as soon as it rains, so every spring my mother moves the things beside them a little farther out.
The teacher told everyone not to rush to put up new pictures on the wall, because there was still a lot of dust on it, and if it was not wiped clean, things would soon fall back down.
The doctor said it is not good for a child to read facing a wall that is too close, and that it would be better to move the desk back a little so there is more open space in front of the eyes.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 医院最近一直在强化夜班安排，不是想让大家更累，而是晚上来看急诊的人明显比以前多了。
老师说，学过的东西如果不反复用，就很难真正记住，所以复习的过程其实就是在不断强化理解。
公司这次没有急着换掉旧系统，而是先强化最容易出问题的几个部分，这样花的钱少，效果也更直接。

example_translations.translation: The hospital has recently been strengthening its night-shift arrangements, not because it wants to make everyone more tired, but because there are clearly more emergency patients at night than before.
The teacher said that if you do not use what you have learned again and again, it is hard to truly remember it, so the process of review is really a process of constantly reinforcing understanding.
This time the company did not rush to replace the old system, but first strengthened the few parts most likely to have problems, which cost less money and produced a more direct result.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective, verb.

examples.sentence: 这孩子看上去不算特别高，可是身体一直很强壮，所以每天跑完那么远的路也很少喊累。
医生提醒他，想让自己更强壮，不能只靠周末突然多练几个小时，平时的睡眠和吃饭也一样重要。
父亲年轻时常觉得只有看起来很强壮的人才算健康，后来才明白，真正稳定的状态比一时有力更难得。

example_translations.translation: This child does not look especially tall, but he has always been physically strong, so even after running that far every day, he rarely says he is tired.
The doctor reminded him that if he wants to become stronger, he cannot rely only on suddenly exercising for a few extra hours on weekends; everyday sleep and meals matter just as much.

When my father was young, he often felt that only people who looked strong counted as healthy. Only later did he understand that a truly stable condition is harder to achieve than a burst of strength.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 老师没有强迫大家立刻说自己同不同意，而是先把材料发下去，让每个人回去想清楚以后第二天再回答。
父亲说，让孩子想学，不是强迫他坐在那里两个小时，而是先让他知道自己为什么要学。
公司后来规定下班以后不要再频繁发消息，因为长期强迫人一直在线，只会让效率越来越低。

example_translations.translation: The teacher did not force everyone to say immediately whether they agreed or not, but first handed out the materials and let each person think things through at home before answering the next day.
My father said that getting a child to want to study is not about forcing the child to sit there for two hours, but first helping the child understand why they are learning.
The company later set a rule against sending frequent messages after work, because forcing people to stay online all the time only makes efficiency lower and lower.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as verb.

examples.sentence: 你先别急着下结论，等医生把后面的片子都拿来，再仔细瞧一遍，说不定问题没有想的那么严重。
老人每天出门以前都要站在窗前瞧一眼外面，因为只要风大一点，他就会多带一件衣服。
她走进店里没有马上说买什么，而是先慢慢瞧了几圈，后来才停在最里面那排旧书前面。

example_translations.translation: Do not rush to a conclusion yet. Wait until the doctor brings the rest of the films over and then look through them carefully again. The problem may not be as serious as you think.
Before going out each day, the old man always stands by the window and takes a look outside, because if the wind is even a little strong, he will bring one more piece of clothing.
When she walked into the shop, she did not immediately say what she wanted to buy. Instead, she slowly looked around a few times before stopping in front of the row of old books at the back.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 这座桥梁修好以后，原来要走很远路的人现在很快就能过去，所以后来每天从这里走的人也慢慢多了起来。
老师常说，语言不只是交流工具，有时候更像一座桥梁，能把原来互相不了解的人慢慢连起来。
如果医院和家里之间没有像桥梁一样的人，很多老人就算有需要，也不知道该先找谁把话说清楚。

example_translations.translation: After this bridge was repaired, people who used to have to travel a long way could get across quickly, so the number of people passing here each day gradually rose as well.
The teacher often says that language is not only a tool for communication; sometimes it is more like a bridge that slowly connects people who did not understand one another before.
If there is no person acting like a bridge between the hospital and the family, many elderly people, even when they have a need, do not know whom they should turn to first to explain things clearly.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 她把两段完全不同的经历放在一起讲，前后过渡得非常巧妙，所以大家听完以后都觉得那个主题一下清楚了。
这个小店地方不大，可是老板把灯和镜子安排得很巧妙，一进去就会觉得空间比实际宽很多。
工程师没有加更多机器，而是用一个很巧妙的办法把流程重新排了一遍，结果时间反而省下不少。

example_translations.translation: She brought together two completely different experiences in one story, and the transition between them was extremely clever, so everyone felt the theme suddenly became clear after listening.
This small shop is not large, but the owner arranged the lights and mirrors very ingeniously, so the moment you walk in, the space feels much wider than it really is.
The engineer did not add more machines, but instead used a clever method to reorganize the process, and as a result quite a bit of time was saved.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 医生说，想让老人慢慢好起来，最切实的办法不是一下加很多药，而是先把吃饭和睡觉都照顾好。
这份计划写得再漂亮，如果没有切实的时间表和负责的人，到了真正执行的时候还是容易乱。
老师提醒我们，给别人提建议的时候要尽量切实一点，不要只说大道理，而不管对方眼前能不能做到。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said that if they wanted the elderly person to get better little by little, the most practical method was not to add a lot of medicine all at once, but first to take care of meals and sleep properly.
No matter how beautifully this plan is written, without a practical timetable and people responsible for it, things can still easily become chaotic when it comes time to carry it out.

The teacher reminded us that when giving other people advice, we should make it as realistic as possible instead of speaking only in big principles without caring whether the other person can actually do it right now.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as adjective.

examples.sentence: 他们虽然很多年没有住在一起，可是关系一直很亲密，所以家里一有大事，还是会先互相打电话商量。
老师发现两个孩子最近突然变得太亲密，就先把他们安排到不同地方做事，免得上课时总只顾着说话。
真正让团队合作顺下来的，不一定是大家表面上多亲密，而是出了问题以后还能不能继续信任对方。

example_translations.translation: Although they have not lived together for many years, their relationship has always remained close, so whenever something important happens in the family, they still call one another first to discuss it.

The teacher noticed that the two children had suddenly become too close lately, so the teacher arranged for them to work in different places first so that class time would not keep turning into conversation.
What truly keeps team cooperation moving smoothly is not necessarily how close people seem on the surface, but whether they can continue trusting one another after problems appear.

glosses.notes: Imported from the source PDF. The source marks this entry as noun.

examples.sentence: 医生解释病情的时候，除了病人自己，旁边的亲属也一直认真记着，因为后面很多照顾上的细节都要靠家里配合。
公司处理那件意外以后，先联系的不是媒体，而是当事人的亲属，希望最重要的消息能由家里第一时间知道。
老人年纪大了以后，很多手续都需要亲属陪着去办，所以表姐每个月都会专门留两天出来陪他跑这些地方。

example_translations.translation: When the doctor explained the illness, not only the patient but also the relatives standing nearby kept taking careful notes, because many later details of care would depend on cooperation from the family.
After handling that accident, the company contacted not the media first, but the person’s relatives, hoping the most important news could be known by the family at the earliest moment.

After the old man became advanced in age, many procedures required a relative to go along and handle them, so my older female cousin now deliberately sets aside two days each month to take him around to do these things.
